tasks.prompt: This is the source tree of a TypeScript project. The module src/platform/http/retry.ts is going to move. List every file that has an import, `import type`, `export … from` or dynamic `import()` statement whose module specifier resolves to src/platform/http/retry.ts — the statements that will need a new path. Files that reach it only through another module do not count. Answer with the file paths relative to the project root, one per line. The bash tool is disabled in this environment.

This is the source tree of a TypeScript project. The module src/orders/model/order-line.ts is going to move. List every file that has an import, `import type`, `export … from` or dynamic `import()` statement whose module specifier resolves to src/orders/model/order-line.ts — the statements that will need a new path. Files that reach it only through another module do not count. Answer with the file paths relative to the project root, one per line. The bash tool is disabled in this environment.

This is the source tree of a TypeScript project. Which files import the function `formatMoney` that src/core/money.ts declares? Count a file when one of its import statements binds `formatMoney` (under its own name or an alias), either from src/core/money.ts or from a barrel that re-exports it. Barrels that only re-export it, files that import other names only, and files that merely mention the name do not count. Answer with the file paths relative to the project root, one per line. The bash tool is disabled in this environment.

This is the source tree of a TypeScript project. Find the unused exports of the files directly in src/catalog/utils/. An export is used when a file other than its own imports it: by name, through a barrel that re-exports it (the re-export alone is not a use; a file must import the name from the barrel), or by importing its whole module (`import * as …`, or an `import()` without destructuring). Comments, same-named local variables or functions in other files, and uses inside its own file do not count. Cover every export form (functions, constants, classes, interfaces, types). List each unused export on its own line, formatted `file: name`. The bash tool is disabled in this environment.

This is the source tree of a TypeScript project. Several files mention `resolveTaxRate`. Which file contains the declaration of the exported function `resolveTaxRate` (not a re-export, an import or a same-named local)? Answer with that file path relative to the project root on the first line. The bash tool is disabled in this environment.

This is the source tree of a TypeScript project. Which files depend on src/loyalty/utils/points-math.ts directly or through exactly one intermediate file? File A depends directly on module M when A has an import, `import type`, `export … from` or dynamic `import()` statement whose module specifier resolves to M. List every file that depends directly on points-math.ts, plus every file that depends directly on one of those files. Do not list points-math.ts itself. Answer with the file paths relative to the project root, one per line. The bash tool is disabled in this environment.
